events.summary: Speaker B presented the prototype: a wheel, a power button, and a squishy rubbery base that is interchangeable.
events.speaker: B
events.quote: the base of the remote control, which has a squishy spongy rubbery feel, is interchangeable

events.summary: Speaker B reported the button is the power button when held down and brings up the menu when tapped.
events.speaker: B
events.quote: serves as the power button if you hold it down

events.summary: Speaker B proposed trendy fruit designs such as mango instead of ordinary fruit like orange.
events.speaker: B
events.quote: You don't have orange, you have mango

events.summary: Speaker B said people would be encouraged to buy three or five interchangeable covers, since they need to switch them out.
events.speaker: B
events.quote: people will be encouraged to buy three or five of them

events.summary: Speaker C reported the size should be hand-holdable and the battery case must still fit inside.
events.speaker: C
events.quote: we will have to fit the battery case in there somehow

events.summary: Speaker B reported the locator is a chip with a beeper inside the remote, with its button still to be designed.
events.speaker: B
events.quote: the locator is just chip that's inside there

events.summary: Speaker A recorded that the team decided on batteries and the regular chip for the iPod-style button.
events.speaker: A
events.quote: we decided on batteries, and the regular chip would be necessary

events.summary: Speaker A proposed an uncurved or flat shape for the plastic part, and asked whether this matched the design.
events.speaker: A
events.quote: I said uncurved or flat. I think that's what you have there

events.summary: Speaker A proposed plastic around the button, rubber for the squishy part, and many special colours.
events.speaker: A
events.quote: rubber would be the squishy like thing right

events.summary: Speaker A said the updated production cost spreadsheet totals 11.90, which is under the 12.50 budget.
events.speaker: A
events.quote: that would make our total of eleven point nine, which is even less than twelve point five

events.summary: Speaker D set the evaluation scale: one is true and seven is false.
events.speaker: D
events.quote: True is one and and false is seven

events.summary: Speaker A decided each member rates separately and the group then discusses the ratings.
events.speaker: A
events.quote: we can do it separately and then discuss it

events.summary: Speaker D said the worst average rating was 3.1, for the material criterion.
events.speaker: D
events.quote: the worst ones were three point one

events.summary: Speaker C proposed flattening the vegetables so the remote is easier to hold in the hand.
events.speaker: C
events.quote: What if we just smash all the vegetables down flat

events.summary: Speaker B objected that the base should be larger, since some shapes are not easy to hold.
events.speaker: B
events.quote: I think the base would definitely be larger, 'cause some of these are not as easy to hold

events.summary: Speaker A objected that the current fruit shapes are not comfortable to hold in an awkward sitting position.
events.speaker: A
events.quote: I personally don't think this is comfortable to to sit there

events.summary: Speaker C objected that the flattened shape is still too big in the hand.
events.speaker: C
events.quote: But it's still too big I think, in your hand

events.summary: Speaker A objected that a flattened shape would not resemble fruit.
events.speaker: A
events.quote: And would it even resemble fruit that way

events.summary: Speaker A proposed the shape could be any shape with a printed fruit design on the rubber.
events.speaker: A
events.quote: the sh shape could be whatever we wanted and then it would just be like a design on the rubber

events.summary: Speaker B proposed keeping one shape and using different colours named after fruits.
events.speaker: B
events.quote: We could make it that shape but just have different colours, and call 'em the different fruits

events.summary: Speaker A proposed a joystick-like round shape that fits the iPod idea and is comfortable to hold.
events.speaker: A
events.quote: that fits the whole round iPod idea. And you still have the comfort of holding it like that

events.summary: Speaker A proposed putting fruit designs on the joystick-shaped part.
events.speaker: A
events.quote: you could put fruit designs and stuff on that part

events.summary: Speaker B said the batteries would probably go on the front or the side of the remote.
events.speaker: B
events.quote: they'd probably be either on the front or the side of the remote

events.summary: Speaker B decided the battery goes on a side, not the front, because the IR sender is on the front.
events.speaker: B
events.quote: it can't be in the front 'cause the I_R_'s right there, but it'd be on one of the sides probably

events.summary: Speaker C said the broccoli shape wins, so the shape should change, and Speaker B agreed.
events.speaker: C
events.quote: Well Yeah the broccoli I guess wins

events.summary: Speaker B objected that using one shape for all buttons would annoy people who get used to it.
events.speaker: B
events.quote: It might also sort of annoy people if we get used to having the buttons in one shape

events.summary: Speaker A objected that irregular shapes would cost more to produce.
events.speaker: A
events.quote: And it would probably cost more to produce, 'cause they're irregular

events.summary: Speaker B said different colours are a lot cheaper than different shapes.
events.speaker: B
events.quote: I bet having different colours is a lot cheaper than having different shapes

events.summary: Speaker A proposed printing the fruit on the fruit shape, which keeps cost down.
events.speaker: A
events.quote: printing might be like just printing the fruit on fruit

events.summary: Speaker B objected that watching a two hour meeting video is excessive, since a missed meeting can be summed up in a sentence.
events.speaker: B
events.quote: I wouldn't need to have to watch like a t two hour video

events.summary: Speaker A reported the group agreed the product is satisfactory, fits the budget and is trendy.
events.speaker: A
events.quote: it fits the budget, and it's trendy
